instruction: My roommate requested me to pay for my share of the housing bill this month on venmo today. But they forgot about the 10% rent decrease starting this month. So reject that payment request and send them the corrected amount of money with a note, "The rent decreased by 10% this month.".
notes: The roommate is identified via phone.search_contacts(relationship='roommate'); their email is then used to locate today's housing payment request among venmo received requests. The 10% decrease is encoded discretely with a static (ten-percent-less amount-corrected amount-requested) fact; show_received_payment_requests reveals the request id and derives the corrected amount. Goal demands the request be denied (only denied_at changes) and exactly one new transaction to the roommate with the corrected amount and the exact note; complete_task carries the goal records as non-API parameters so it must be last.

plan: (venmo-show-received-payment-requests phone-token roommate roommate-email housing-request amount-requested amount-corrected)
(venmo-create-transaction roommate-email amount-corrected phone-token note-rent-decreased-10-percent roommate housing-request)
